name: white-screen-diagnosis
task_summary: Reproduce 5173 white screen and isolate cache cause
description: Diagnose unified site runtime white screen

spawn_spec.prompt:
Investigate the reported white screen at http://localhost:5173 in /Users/indo/code/project/orca-lite. Do NOT edit files.

Context: The site was migrated from Vite React to Astro + Starlight + React. A prior Astro server log showed browser requests to `/src/main.tsx` and `/sw.js`, both 404. Those are stale Vite/service-worker paths. A prior isolated Playwright browser saw the page render, but the user sees a blank white screen.

Must do:
1. Check whether port 5173 is currently served, and if not start the site's normal dev command temporarily (stop it after evidence capture).
2. Use Playwright with browser console/pageerror/requestfailed/response logging to load `/`, inspect HTML, network requests, service worker registrations, and screenshot.
3. Distinguish at least these causes using evidence: stale browser document/cache/service worker; Astro/React hydration error; server process absent/wrong server.
4. Read current Astro landing files/config enough to identify the smallest safe remediation. Do not make changes.
5. Return verbatim observable evidence (URLs/status/errors) plus one concrete remediation recommendation.

Success: identify a root cause or clearly state what remains unproven. Never invent observed output.
